implementationNotes: 6 distinct core products; do not count 15/30/50 ml variants as distinct formulas.

Use exact query attributes and actual 50 ml photos. Verify every proposed URL before release.
Source body cream uses 50 ml as its only available pack; no invented larger pack.

Do not label oil serum as water-based. Do not repeat ingredient-only medicinal claims as product efficacy.
